prompt: In a chaotic robot workshop, a large red bipedal robot is standing in front of a long metal workbench. The robot's design is sleek and new, contrasting with the small, older-looking blue quadcopter drone hovering to its left. The workbench shows numerous scratches and scorch marks, appearing more worn than the pristine, newer-looking toolbox nearby. The robot has a camera for a head and is using its right claw-hand to hold a glowing green power cell, which is the brightest object in the scene. The robot is simultaneously using its left hand to push the toolbox. The blue drone is facing the robot and holding a tiny screwdriver, pointing the screwdriver at a panel on the robot's chest. A detailed schematic diagram is lying flat on top of the workbench. Near the diagram are some loose screws. Under the workbench, there are three broken gears. The number of screws on the workbench is one more than the number of broken gears. The toolbox has a handle on its top. The robot is between the drone and the workbench. A single red cable is connecting the power cell to the robot's chest. The robot is looking at the drone. The drone is hovering above the floor but below the robot's head. The toolbox contains more tools than are lying on the workbench. A robotic arm, which is a component of the workbench itself, is holding a welding torch and pointing it away from the robot.
